title.zh: 彭博终端现已支持全天候监测Hyperliquid上部分永续合约

current_state.zh: Bloomberg Terminal has begun supporting round-the-clock monitoring of selected Hyperliquid perpetual contracts across crypto, equities, commodities, FX and indices, without trading execution, expanding the venue's institutional data distribution.
